description: Create a blocklist automation rule. Write action; requires confirmation.

applicationKeys.description: Application keys when not applying to all applications.

conditions.description: Condition array. Fields include abuseConfidenceScore, riskScore, alertName, alertTag, attackType, path, environment.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

environments.description: Deployment environments when not applying to all environments.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

status.description: Initial rule status: active or disabled. Defaults to active.

name: securenow_automation_rule_create
title: Create Automation Rule
